messages:
Sonia (partnerships): Heads-up
Marketplace compliance reviewers asked for a single source of truth: how long we keep SOC/pen-tests/questionnaires and what metadata we store. Can we agree defaults?\nEli (security): Suggest baseline: SOC2 Type II = 15 months, Pen-test reports = 24 months, Short questionnaires = 12 months. All items require KMS encryption and download audit logs.
Priya (legal): Contract default = 12 months but add clause for extended retention per marketplace/enterprise. Need chain-of-custody fields: vendor, test date, scope, signed attestation. Also state redaction/NDA process for external auditors.
Jared (eng-ops): Tech plan: uploader accepts tags `retain_months`, `sensitivity`, `marketplace`. Persist metadata in ledger (DynamoDB) with TTL. Lifecycle rules by tag; opt-in for long-term archive (cold storage) if partners pay. Example: `curl -X POST /upload -F file=@r.pdf -F retain_months=24 -F pentest_vendor=AcmeSec`.
Alex (partner-success): Partners expect notice before purge. Recommend emails at 60/30/7 days. Also let listing owners opt into archive.
upload-bot: Lifecycle rule `marketplace-tagged-retain` added to s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts by jared at 2026-04-07T02:10Z.
Eli (security): For `sensitivity:high` items disallow auto-delete and require manual approval to purge. Save SHA256 checksum + uploader id for audit.
Priya (legal): I'll draft the contract blurb and redaction process.
Jared (eng-ops): I'll add the uploader fields, lifecycle by tag, SNS notifications, and an audit event on downloads. Target: next sprint.
Sonia (partnerships): Great. Action items: Priya contract blurb; Eli finalize sensitivity matrix; Jared implement uploader + notifications; Alex to collect partner archive interest. I'll update the onboarding checklist after those are done.
